title: 30A Serenity Sands | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled in the vibrant heart of Gulf Place, this newly constructed coastal retreat blends modern elegance with effortless comfort, making it the perfect setting for family reunions or corporate retreats. The home’s spacious design centers around an expansive kitchen island seating fourteen, complemented by open living spaces ideal for gathering. Outdoors, a private heated pool and spa await, while multiple balconies and patios provide tranquil spots to relax and enjoy the sea breeze. With peek-a-boo Gulf views and thoughtful details throughout, every moment here is crafted to elevate your beach getaway. Steps from Gulf Place’s charming streets, this home offers seamless access to a variety of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. From the renowned Shunk Gulley to quaint nature trails and picturesque green spaces, the area is designed to slow the pace and inspire connection. Whether sharing meals, exploring the local scene, or unwinding poolside, this Gulf Place gem delivers a truly unforgettable coastal escape.
